items.title: Vanishing of the top local cohomology of one finite module of full support forces the cohomological dimension of the ideal to drop
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a converse-type criterion: if the top local cohomology vanishes for one finite module whose support contains all the components of maximal dimension, then the cohomological dimension of the ideal is strictly smaller than the dimension of the ring (author lemma at source lines 3596-3602, label lemma-cd-top-vanishing-some-module). The proof (source lines 3604-3629) isolates the vanishing property of the top local cohomology, checks its behaviour under direct sums and quotients using the a priori dimension bound, reduces the problem to the minimal primes of maximal dimension via the modules M/p_i M, and then invokes a structural statement of another chapter to conclude that the property holds for all finite modules (proof lines 3624-3628). The reduction to the modules supported on the minimal primes is the content. H3.
